facts.fact: The Prime Minister launched the FasoSign national e-signature platform on 15 September 2026; ANSSI's director general says it provides formal authentication of the signer and is already operational.
ANSSI's director general says FasoSign is already operational on three government systems: SIGED (official correspondence), CIMEXT (mission orders) and SYC@D (land cession orders).

BFA.note: ANSSI presents the platform; no incident, designation, strategy or figures are stated.
Keys and data of one platform stay in the country, but no rule requiring it is stated.

facts.fact: The article says the FasoSign keys, certificates and data stay hosted on national territory under the control of Burkinabe engineers.
The article says law 045-2009 of 10 November 2009 regulating electronic services and transactions, with its implementing decrees, gives a digital signature the same legal value as a handwritten one.
ANSSI's director general says FasoSign is operational on SYC@D, the system managing the cadastre, state domain and land, for issuing signed provisional cession orders.
